content:
Post 1
📉 ASX 200 shed 4.21% for the period, closing at 8,709.30. A 0.34% bounce on the final session masked a bruising run — the index lost 0.55% in the last five days alone and is virtually flat year to date. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2
🔻 Info Tech cratered 11.64% and Materials fell 9.73% — the two heaviest drags on the ASX 200. Health Care was the lone bright spot, gaining 2.08%. Financials held firm, off just 0.22%. #ASX #ausbiz #tech #materials

Post 3
CODAN LIMITED surged 23.93% to lead the ASX 200, with MEGAPORT LIMITED close behind at +9.44%. Two names bucking a market down 4.21% — standout outperformance in a month where most sectors fell. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 4
Materials off 9.73% and Info Tech down 11.64% tells the macro story: risk-off pressure hit growth and commodity-linked names hardest. Health Care's +2.08% gain signals a defensive rotation was underway. #ASX #mining #ausbiz

Post 5
ASX 200 sits at 8,709.30, virtually unchanged YTD after a 4.21% slide. Can Health Care's defensive bid hold if Materials and Tech extend losses into October? Bulls or bears — where do you see the index by month-end? #ASX #ausbiz
